title: NEW MSFS 2024 Aircraft Drops! Azure Poly Rafale C, Ilyushin IL-18D & Quirky Homebuilts
description:
Are you looking to invest in your Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 hangar this week, or are you trying to navigate past the storefront landmines? Today, we are breaking down a massive wave of recent Marketplace aircraft releases that offer an incredible spread of flight dynamics—from Mach-capable delta-wing fighters to Cold War heavy turboprops and quirky grassroots ultralights.

In this deep-dive marketplace breakdown, we climb into the cockpits of these brand-new airframes to evaluate system depth, flight model promises, custom audio, and overall visual fidelity to see which add-ons genuinely deserve a spot in your virtual hangar:

✈️ HIGH-PERFORMANCE MILITARY OPERATIONS
We lead with the highly anticipated Dassault Rafale C by Azure Poly and JFXP. Built natively for MSFS 2024 over two years, this modern delta-wing fighter brings a custom fly-by-wire system, terrain-following radar, interactive payload options, external pilot animations, and 14 detailed liveries (plus a dedicated special display bundle). We also inspect Flight Replicas' new low-back Spitfire, featuring an authentic Merlin 266 powerplant and classic RAF warbird craftsmanship.

🛩️ HEAVY VINTAGE LOGISTICS
Next, Nemeth Designs brings classic Soviet long-range aviation back to life with the Ilyushin IL-18D. Powered by four AI-20M turboprops, this legendary 1950s airliner features an analog cockpit packed with traditional steam gauges, vintage flight deck ergonomics, and commanding ramp presence.

🪵 GRASSROOTS & EXPERIMENTAL GA
For low-and-slow barnstorming fans, RARA AVIS SIMS delivers two eccentric homebuilts. The Flying Flea (HM.14) features a tandem-wing design powered by a 2-stroke engine, complete with ski/wheel configurations, custom VR support, and a hidden GPS. Alongside it, the post-war French Jodel D92 brings simple wooden homebuilt flying to life with a VW engine, micro-vibrations, and removable engine covers.

Which of these airframes are you taking up for your first test flight? Pulling high-G maneuvers in the Rafale C, managing four turboprops in the IL-18D, or barnstorming in the Flying Flea? Let us know in the comments below!

If you enjoy honest, data-driven, and critical looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and clear skies on your next departure!
